title: Pre-collision velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The student must compute the magnitude of the block's velocity just before impact as 5 m/s.

title: Pre-collision velocity direction
description: Essential: The student must state the velocity is perpendicular to the inclined plane (or equivalent, e.g., parallel to the vertical).

title: Minimum board length
description: Essential: The student must calculate the minimum length of the wooden board as 0.06 m.

title: Initial distance to baffle
description: Essential: The student must determine the initial distance between the board's front end and the baffle as 0.43 m.

title: Accelerations analysis
description: Important: The student must correctly derive the three distinct accelerations (board alone, board with block, block relative to board) using Newton's second law.

title: Collision condition application
description: Important: The student must apply the condition that the block's velocity component perpendicular to the incline becomes zero after collision.

title: Relative motion setup
description: Important: The student must set up the kinematic equations for the relative motion between the block and board to find the time to equal velocities.

title: Projectile motion time
description: Optional: The student may calculate the block's fall time (0.4 s) as an intermediate step.

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall: Deduct if the student uses an incorrect sign for the friction force on the board, leading to wrong acceleration.

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall: Deduct if final answers lack correct units (m/s, m, degrees) or use inconsistent units in calculations.
